slot.brief: Give radius ratio scenario or an ionic compound in an hcp/fcc lattice; ask how many octahedral and tetrahedral voids per unit cell / per atom, or which voids are occupied to give the formula

stem: An fcc unit cell contains anions at its lattice points. How many octahedral and tetrahedral voids are present per unit cell, respectively?

verdicts.working: An fcc unit cell has 4 lattice points. It contains 4 octahedral voids and 2×4 = 8 tetrahedral voids.

working:
fcc contains $4$ particles per unit cell. Octahedral voids $=4$; tetrahedral voids $=2(4)=8$.

Independent check: An fcc unit cell has 4 lattice points. It contains 4 octahedral voids and 2×4 = 8 tetrahedral voids.
solution:
An fcc unit cell contains $4$ lattice points. The number of octahedral voids equals the number of lattice points, while tetrahedral voids are twice that number:
$$N_{\text{octahedral}}=4,\qquad N_{\text{tetrahedral}}=2(4)=8$$
Thus, the numbers are $(4,8)$.
